assets.name: 01-left-seat-closeup
assets.prompt: Edit the reference image into a new camera-angle photograph of the EXACT SAME empty podcast studio. Deliver ONE landscape 16:9 image, no collage. Shot 1: medium-close single-host background plate focused on the original LEFT purple chair and its black microphone. Camera is moved to the front-right side of the table and pointed diagonally toward the original left host position, at seated small-host eye height. The left seat is the main subject, its empty face area centered above the chair. The corresponding tabletop segment fills the lower quarter, its mic on the same compact desk arm visible low and off to the side of the face area. The oak built-in shelving with the same plants, books and warm brass lamp is behind that chair. Include natural perspective parallax and oblique tabletop/chair perspective, not just a crop of the reference. Preserve the actual room geography: bookshelf is on original left, purple wall acoustic panels unchanged, cream door remains on original right behind the other chair and can naturally be outside this tight frame. The other host chair is out of frame or only a tiny peripheral edge. Preserve exact chair design, fluted oak oval table, same mic hardware, cream walls, books/plants, purple accent lighting and amber shelf glow. No furnishing redesign, no additional microphones, no new decoration, no changes in lighting or color grade. Photoreal interior with clear subject placement for later character compositing. Empty seat, no characters, no people, no animals, no text, no logo, no watermark. Horizontal 16:9.

assets.name: 02-right-seat-closeup
assets.prompt: Edit the provided original wide empty podcast studio photo to produce ONE matching reverse-angle background plate in landscape 16:9, not a collage. Shot 2: medium-close single-host camera view of the original RIGHT purple velvet chair and its corresponding black desk microphone. Move camera to front-left of the table and aim diagonally toward the original right host seat, at seated small-host eye level, making a complementary conversational reverse angle to a left-seat close-up. Frame the right chair prominently, its empty face space centered above its backrest, with the corresponding low microphone at lower right or right edge so it will not obscure a future character face. Near oak tabletop occupies lower quarter of the image at an oblique angle; show actual camera parallax and perspective, not a digital crop. Preserve room geography: cream closed door is behind this original right chair toward camera-left/center as perspective dictates, purple acoustic wall panels and the large potted plant are on original right wall. Bookshelf remains on original left of room and can be mostly outside frame. All furniture stays in original places, same table, same chair design, same mic/compact articulated arm, same warm cream walls and golden oak floor. No new furniture or lamps. Original warm amber soft lighting, restrained purple wall accent, same warm grade and photoreal materials. Other chair out of frame or tiny edge only. Tabletop empty. No characters, people, animals, text, logo, book on table, strawberries, truck, watermark. Output horizontal 16:9.

assets.name: 03-diagonal-wide
assets.prompt: Use the supplied image as an exact room-continuity reference. Create a third new photographic CAMERA ANGLE of this SAME empty podcast studio. ONE standalone horizontal 16:9 image. Wide diagonal establishing shot from the FRONT-LEFT corner of the room, camera moved roughly 35 degrees left from the original straight-on position, looking across the oval oak table toward the original two purple host chairs and cream back-right door. Camera at seated-host eye level, 28-35mm natural interior lens. Make the viewpoint visibly diagonal: long axis of oval table recedes from near-left to far-right, original left chair a little nearer/larger than original right chair, microphones aligned to their original seats, visible perspective depth. Frame both chairs, BOTH and only two black short desk microphones, complete table with its two fluted thick legs, circular cream/purple rug and substantial oak floor. Keep clear doorway and aisle visible to viewer right, useful for the toy truck entrance in a later scene. Preserve unchanged world-space layout: oak illuminated bookshelf occupies original LEFT back wall with its slatted wood frame, identical books/plants/cream ceramics and small brass lamp; original cream door on original RIGHT rear wall, large plant to its right, same deep purple acoustic panels, no new walls/windows. Do not mirror or move room elements. Match original cozy photoreal textures, warm amber lighting, subtle purple panel glow, color grade and furniture designs exactly. Full scene, no collage, no typography, no people or characters, no animals, no mascot, no book on table, no strawberries, no truck, no logo, no watermark. This must be a new diagonal viewpoint with parallax, not simply the original front shot at a different crop.
